{{Top|leg}}
'''Orbital relay satellites''' were small transmitters used to extend the range of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and communcations. At least three of the [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] were needed to give a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the ability to send communications to any portion of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|418|orbital relay satellites}}</ref>
